description: Phase 1: process a begins a transaction and inserts key 300; process b (no transaction) inserts key 300 and then key 301, errors recorded; a rolls back; b inserts key 300 again and reads keys of 300 and above. Phase 2: a begins and inserts key 310; b inserts key 310 and key 311; a commits; b inserts key 310 again and reads. Asks how a concurrent uniqueness candidate on the primary key and on index IX_N is resolved against an uncommitted and then a committed insert.
